title: Sars-CoV2 RNA Purification with Homemade SPRI Beads for RT-qPCR Test
author: Ayelet Rahat
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.beswjefe

steps.title: Dilute Clinical Samples
steps.instruction: Inactivate clinical samples collected in viral transport media by diluting them in lysis/binding buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of lysis/binding buffer to the samples (e.g., add 28 µl buffer to 28 µl sample).
Ensure the total volume does not exceed x3.6 the original sample volume to maintain efficient robotic pipettation.

steps.title: Bind RNA to SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Bind the RNA to SPRI beads and isolate them using a magnet.

substeps.instruction: Add x0.8 volume of SPRI beads to each diluted sample (e.g., 45 µl beads to 56 µl diluted sample).
Mix by pipetting 10 times, avoiding aeration to prevent foaming.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 25 °C, mixing periodically by pipetting.
Magnetize the plate until the solution clears completely (approximately 5 minutes).
Slowly aspirate and discard the supernatant, ensuring the beads are not disturbed.

steps.title: Wash Beads with 80% EtOH
steps.instruction: Wash the magnetized beads to remove impurities using 80% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Move the plate from one side of the magnet to the other to immerse the beads in the wash solution.
Remove the wash solution while the plate remains on the magnet.
Perform an extra aspiration of residual EtOH using a fine tip.
Remove the plate from the magnet and air dry the beads at 30 °C for approximately 2.5 minutes (until dry by eye inspection), avoiding overdrying.

steps.title: Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA from the beads using Tris buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 10mM Tris pH 8 at 10 °C - 22 °C (e.g., 20 µL for 56 µl beads).
Fully resuspend the beads in the elution buffer by pipetting.
Incubate for 2 minutes to allow full RNA elution.
Place the plate on the magnet and wait for the solution to clear (approximately 1 minute).
While keeping the plate on the magnet, transfer the supernatant to a new plate without disturbing the beads.
